title: High Availability & Disaster Recovery
description: Ensure business continuity with Always On Availability Groups, database mirroring, and comprehensive backup/restore strategies.
longDescription: This module covers SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery (HADR) technologies including Always On Availability Groups, database mirroring, failover clustering, and backup/restore strategies. You will learn to design RPO/RTO-aligned recovery solutions and implement monitoring for failover events.
whatYouLearn: Configure Always On Availability Groups for high availability
Understand database mirroring and its role in disaster recovery
Design and implement comprehensive backup and restore strategies
Calculate RPO and RTO for business continuity planning
Monitor HADR health and configure automatic failover
